purpose: Functional role comparison, not an assessment of someone's human worth or theological truth.
important: Historical events, fictional narratives, religious claims and legends are explicitly distinguished. An attached link does not prove every interpretation; entries without links are starting points for research.

entries.name: Gilgamesh
entries.proof: His quest for immortality fails in the epic
